name: Can AEO help my CPA firm specialize in a niche, such as small business tax or forensic accounting?
description: AEO can help CPA firms specialize by using AI to target niche-specific search queries and online discussions, attracting relevant clients.

mainEntity.name: Can AEO help my CPA firm specialize in a niche, such as small business tax or forensic accounting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AEO is highly effective for CPA firms looking to specialize in a niche. AI tools can precisely identify search queries and online discussions related to specific services like small business tax or forensic accounting. This allows for hyper-targeted content creation, ad campaigns, and website optimization, ensuring your firm's online presence directly appeals to the exact clientele you wish to serve, rather than a broad audience. This increases lead quality and relevance.
